The following events took place in approximately '''11,933 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] severs all ties with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] over the [[Pius Dea Crusades]], beginning its [[Recusal]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. The Jedi still loyal to the Pius Dea cult form the [[Order of the Terrible Glare/Legends|Order of the Terrible Glare]] and settle on [[Garn/Legends|Garn]].<ref name="EGW" />
